adjudication.rationale: The diff does show a Promise rejection inside the new Salesforce refresh-token flow: `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { return Promise.reject(new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")); }` in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`. However, this is not a verifiable bug—inside an `async` function, `return Promise.reject(...)` behaves equivalently to `throw ...` (it rejects the returned promise). The finding is essentially a style/anti-pattern suggestion rather than a defect or substantial review issue.
